text:
I'm so sorry, that must be really scary. Please do this first:

- **Contact your doctor or local poison control right now.** Peace lilies aren't safe to eat, so please get their advice even if your toddler seems fine. If your toddler has trouble breathing or swallowing, or seems very unwell, call emergency services.
- Keep the plant out of your toddler's reach in the meantime.

I'm also escalating this to a Support Lead as a safety issue, so a person from our team will follow up with you. Please have your order number handy (it looks like LF-123456).

**The smashed pot**

A smashed pot counts as damaged on arrival, and you're well within the window. Here's what to do:

- Report it from "My Orders" **within 48 hours of delivery**.
- Include photos of the plant and the box, and please keep the box until this is sorted.
- Once it's confirmed, you can choose a **free replacement on the next plant shipping day** (plants ship Monday to Wednesday) or a **refund**.

Please look after your little one first. The order can wait until you've spoken to a medical professional. If you have any questions afterwards, just reach out to us.
